aka.zh: 烟威高速公路（烟台至威海段）

aka.en: Baoding–Tianjin Expressway (the original line through Xiong'an)
aka.zh: 保津高速公路（原穿越雄安段）

tagline.en: From the eastern tip of the Shandong peninsula along the Bohai coast, over the Taihang and Hengshan ranges to the Yellow River at Wuhai
tagline.zh: 自山东半岛东端沿渤海湾西行，越太行、恒山，直抵黄河岸边的乌海

start.en: Lasengmiao in Hainan district, Wuhai, Inner Mongolia, at the Erdaokan bridge interchange with the Beijing–Lhasa expressway (G6)
start.zh: 内蒙古自治区乌海市海南区拉僧庙，京藏高速二道坎大桥立交

end.en: Rongcheng interchange, Rongcheng, Weihai, at the eastern tip of the Shandong peninsula, joining provincial road S203
end.zh: 山东省威海市荣成市荣成立交，接 203 省道

en: G18 is the fourth of the eighteen east–west lines in the national expressway plan. Chinese Wikipedia's chainage table gives 1,771 km; the provincial announcements at its completion gave 1,820 km. It leaves Rongcheng at the eastern end of the Shandong peninsula, runs along the peninsula's north coast through Weihai, Yantai, Penglai, Longkou and Laizhou, crosses the Weifang coast to Dongying and the Yellow River delta, and passes Binzhou into Hebei at Haixing and Huanghua. It then runs through southern Tianjin, Bazhou and Yongqing in Langfang and the Xiong'an New Area to Baoding, climbs into the Taihang mountains by Yi county and Laiyuan, and enters Shanxi through the Yimaling tunnel. Past Lingqiu, Hunyuan, Ying county, Shanyin and Pinglu it crosses into Inner Mongolia at the Erdaoliang tunnel and runs across Ordos — Jungar Banner, Kangbashi, Hangjin and Otog — to Wuhai.

Shandong carries 620 km, Inner Mongolia 497 km, Shanxi 267 km and Tianjin 79 km; Hebei has two pieces, 78 km on the coast and 230 km inland. Between Binzhou and Tianjin it shares its carriageway with G25, the Changchun–Shenzhen expressway, and around Tianjin and Langfang it runs for stretches on other expressways.

The eastern end is still not continuous. From Rongcheng the road shares the Rongcheng–Weifang expressway to Wendeng and then the Weihai–Qingdao expressway north to Caomiaozi on the edge of Weihai, and the gap to the Weihai–Yantai section is being closed by a new 31.8 km road from Wendeng to the Beihai interchange in Weihai. Its builder, Shandong Hi-Speed Group, calls it the last dead end on the national network in Shandong.
zh: G18 是国家高速公路网 18 条东西横线中的第 4 条。中文维基百科的里程表为 1,771 公里；全线贯通时各省公布的数字为 1,820 公里。它自山东半岛东端的荣成出发，沿半岛北岸经威海、烟台、蓬莱、龙口、莱州，穿过潍坊沿海到东营与黄河三角洲，经滨州在海兴、黄骅进入河北。此后经天津南部、廊坊霸州与永清、雄安新区到保定，经易县、涞源进入太行山，穿驿马岭隧道入山西；过灵丘、浑源、应县、山阴、平鲁，在二道梁隧道进入内蒙古，横穿鄂尔多斯的准格尔旗、康巴什、杭锦旗、鄂托克旗，抵达乌海。
山东段 620 公里，内蒙古段 497 公里，山西段 267 公里，天津段 79 公里；河北分为两段，沿海 78 公里、内陆 230 公里。滨州至天津段与 G25 长深高速共线，在天津、廊坊一带还有若干路段借用其他高速公路。
东端至今尚未连续。自荣成出发，线路先与荣潍高速共线至文登，再与威青高速共线北上至威海市区边缘的草庙子；与威海至烟台段之间的缺口，由一条自文登至威海北海立交的 31.8 公里新路补上。建设方山东高速集团称其为国家高速公路网山东段的最后一处断头路。

en: The mountain sections in the west carried most of the engineering. The 121.7 km from Xushui to the Shanxi line at Laiyuan has bridges and tunnels over about 38% of its length, and 58.7% in its mountain part. Its longest tunnel, the Yingerling tunnel, is 5,656 m (left bore) and 5,677 m (right bore) and was built as a twin-bore three-lane-each-way tunnel; during construction, on 30 September 2017, part of the right bore collapsed and trapped nine workers, who were all brought out alive on 4 October after more than ninety hours. In Shanxi the 153.9 km Lingqiu–Shanyin section has 49 large and extra-large bridges and nine tunnels, among them the 5.2 km Hengshan tunnel, holed through in August 2011.

The oldest piece, the 66 km Yantai–Weihai road along the coast, was built as a four-lane class-one road with a concrete surface and opened in 1994. Overloading and uneven settlement of its seaside embankments had it closed for half its width for nine months of repairs in 2008, in which 36 bridges were demolished and rebuilt. Its main line from Weihai to the Yantai–Haiyang expressway, about 47 km, was widened to six lanes, designed for 120 km/h, between 2022 and 2023. The newest piece, the 72.8 km line north of Xiong'an opened in 2021, was built to eight lanes.
zh: 工程量主要集中在西部山区路段。徐水至涞源（冀晋界）121.7 公里，全线桥隧比约 38%，山区路段高达 58.7%。最长的营尔岭隧道左线 5,656 米、右线 5,677 米，为上下行分离式双向六车道特长隧道；2017 年 9 月 30 日施工期间右洞发生坍塌，9 名工人被困，经过 90 多个小时的营救，10 月 4 日全部获救。山西境内灵丘至山阴段 153.9 公里，设特大桥和大桥 49 座、隧道 9 座，其中恒山隧道长约 5.2 公里，2011 年 8 月贯通。
最早的一段是沿海的烟威公路，全长 66 公里，原为双向四车道一级公路，混凝土路面，1994 年通车。因车辆超载、临海路基不均匀沉降，2008 年封闭半幅维修九个月，拆除重建桥梁 36 座。其中威海至烟海高速约 47 公里的主线于 2022 至 2023 年改扩建为双向六车道，设计时速 120 公里。最新的一段是雄安以北 72.8 公里的荣乌新线，2021 年通车，按双向八车道建设。

en: The road was assembled over a quarter of a century. Yantai–Weihai opened in 1994 as Yantai's first expressway. The Baoding–Tianjin expressway through Rongcheng county and Xiongxian, which carried the route across what is now the Xiong'an New Area, was begun in 1995 and opened in December 1999, according to English Wikipedia. The Dongying–Qingzhou expressway, part of which G18 uses, opened in September 2000, Yantai–Xinhe at the end of 2003, and by 28 September 2008 the Shandong section was open apart from the Wendeng–Weihai gap. The numbering came with the national plan of 2005; the Yantai–Weihai road took the G18 signs in 2010.

The west came last. Shanxi began Lingqiu–Shanyin on 10 June 2009 and opened it in stages on 31 December 2010 and 13 March 2012; the 16.6 km Hebei link from Laiyuan to the Shanxi line followed on 24 July 2015. Xushui–Laiyuan was built in two phases, the first 25 km opening at the end of 2011 and the rest, begun on 11 July 2013, on 28 December 2018. Hebei announced that as the closing of the route's last gap, but in Inner Mongolia the 51.9 km Qipanjing–Wuhai section opened only on 1 March 2019, and the regional government in turn described it as the last section.

Since then the route has been rebuilt rather than extended. On 29 May 2021 a new eight-lane line from Yongqing to Dingxing opened north of Xiong'an, taking over the old road's role as the through route for freight across the new area. The main line of the Yantai–Weihai section reopened at six lanes on 29 December 2023, and work on the Wendeng–Weihai link began in September 2023.
zh: 这条路的拼接历时二十余年。烟威公路 1994 年通车，是烟台市第一条高速公路。据英文维基百科，经容城、雄县穿越今雄安新区一带的保津高速公路 1995 年动工，1999 年 12 月通车。G18 借用其中一段的东青高速 2000 年 9 月通车，烟台至新河段 2003 年底通车；至 2008 年 9 月 28 日，山东段除文登至威海缺口外全线通车。编号来自 2005 年的国家高速公路网规划；烟威公路于 2010 年换上 G18 标志。

西段最晚建成。山西灵丘至山阴段 2009 年 6 月 10 日开工，2010 年 12 月 31 日、2012 年 3 月 13 日分段通车；河北涞源至冀晋界 16.6 公里于 2015 年 7 月 24 日通车。徐水至涞源段分两期建设，一期 25 公里于 2011 年底通车，二期 2013 年 7 月 11 日开工，2018 年 12 月 28 日通车。河北方面宣布此举打通了全线最后一个断点；但内蒙古境内 51.9 公里的棋盘井至乌海段直到 2019 年 3 月 1 日才通车，当地政府同样称其为全线最后一段。
此后的工程以改建为主。2021 年 5 月 29 日，雄安以北自永清至定兴的八车道荣乌新线通车，替代原线承担穿越新区的过境货运功能。烟威段主线于 2023 年 12 月 29 日改扩建为六车道通车；文登至威海连接段于 2023 年 9 月动工。

en: No total has been published. The route was built by five provinces and Tianjin as separate projects, and the section figures that are public are mostly for the recent western and Xiong'an work: 10.29 billion yuan budgeted for Xushui–Laiyuan, 8.80 billion approved for Lingqiu–Shanyin, 3.03 billion for Qipanjing–Wuhai, and 19.97 billion budgeted for the 72.8 km Xiong'an new line, which local reports also gave as 23.2 billion.

It is a toll road, built and run by provincial companies: Hebei Expressway Group's Rongwu branch runs the Hebei mountain section, Inner Mongolia Highway Transport Investment and Development Co. runs Qipanjing–Wuhai, and Shandong Hi-Speed Group is building the Wendeng–Weihai link, budgeted at 5.95 billion and funded, according to its tender notices, by the company itself.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G18 由五个省区和天津市分别立项建设，已公开的分段数字多为近年的西段和雄安段工程：徐水至涞源段概算 102.86 亿元，灵丘至山阴段批准概算 87.99 亿元，棋盘井至乌海段 30.34 亿元，72.8 公里的荣乌新线概算 199.72 亿元（地方报道另有约 232.16 亿元的说法）。
它是收费公路，由各省公司建设和运营：河北高速公路集团荣乌分公司管理河北山区段，内蒙古公路交通投资发展有限公司运营棋盘井至乌海段，文登至威海连接段由山东高速集团投资建设，概算 59.5 亿元，招标公告载明资金来源为企业自筹。

en: Through Tianjin and Langfang the signed route is a patchwork: it shares the Changchun–Shenzhen expressway to Tuanbo, then for stretches the Beijing–Shanghai expressway, the Tianjin ring, the Tianjin–Xiong'an expressway and the Beijing–Taipei expressway before the new line begins at Yongqing. At the eastern end, until the Wendeng–Weihai link opens, there is no expressway connection inside Weihai between the end of the Weihai–Qingdao section at Caomiaozi and the start of the Yantai–Weihai section at Zhangcun.
zh: 天津、廊坊一带的路线由多段拼成：与长深高速共线至团泊，此后分段借用京沪高速、天津绕城高速、津雄高速和京台高速，至永清才转入荣乌新线。东端在文登至威海连接段通车之前，威海市区内威青高速共线段终点草庙子与烟威段起点张村之间没有高速公路相连。

why.en: No total has been published. G18 was built between 1994 and 2021 as separately financed projects in Shandong, Hebei, Tianjin, Shanxi and Inner Mongolia, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G18 于 1994 至 2021 年间由山东、河北、天津、山西、内蒙古分别立项筹资、分别核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.zh: 72.8 公里八车道，概算总投资 199.72 亿元（2019—2021）。一地方生活网站另作约 232.16 亿元，差异原因不明。

timeline.en: The Yantai–Weihai road opens, Yantai's first expressway.
timeline.zh: 烟威公路通车，为烟台市第一条高速公路。

timeline.en: The Baoding–Tianjin expressway opens in December.
The Dongying–Qingzhou expressway opens on 16 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 16 日，东青高速公路通车。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers Rongcheng–Wuhai G18, the fourth east–west line.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将荣成至乌海编为 G18，列 18 条横线中的第 4 条。

timeline.en: The Shandong section is open by 28 September, apart from Wendeng–Weihai.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日，山东段除文登至威海段外全线通车。

timeline.en: Hunyuan–Shanyin in Shanxi opens on 31 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，山西浑源至山阴段通车。
3 月 13 日，灵丘至浑源段通车。

timeline.en: Laiyuan–Lingqiu across the Hebei–Shanxi line opens on 24 July; Rongcheng–Wendeng opens on 29 December.
timeline.zh: 7 月 24 日，涞源至灵丘跨省段通车；12 月 29 日，荣成至文登段通车。
12 月 28 日，徐水至涞源段全线通车。

timeline.en: Qipanjing–Wuhai opens on 1 March, the last section in Inner Mongolia.
timeline.zh: 3 月 1 日，内蒙古棋盘井至乌海段通车。

timeline.en: The eight-lane new line north of Xiong'an opens on 29 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 29 日，雄安以北的八车道荣乌新线通车。

timeline.en: Work on the Wendeng–Weihai link begins in September; the Yantai–Weihai main line reopens at six lanes on 29 December.
timeline.zh: 9 月，文登至威海连接段动工；12 月 29 日，烟威段主线六车道改扩建通车。
